action.objective: Win the g6 rook with Rxg6 and convert the extra rook in a simple winning endgame.
action.rationale: Rxg6 was verified at depth 4 with exact score 992, safety complete (no mate-in-one reply, tactical refutation not_found) and is the only commit_ready move. It removes Black's last piece for free, leaving White a rook up with a straightforward win. Black's king must step aside; White then advances pawns.
